checks.S1: policy file SHA-256 equals the digest recorded at selection
checks.S2: every dependency and record file is present with its recorded SHA-256
checks.S3: the recorded evaluation was made with the case's environment, gamma and test seeds (identical lists)
checks.S4: seed contract: non-empty lists of nonnegative integers (no bool, float or string; nothing coerced), no duplicates, validation and test disjoint
checks.S5: every reward parameter and gamma is finite
checks.S6: every recorded episode has finite original return, training return and every declared term
checks.S7: training return = weight x original return + sum of term returns (1e-9 relative)
checks.S8: recorded per-step shaping values equal alpha*(gamma*Phi(s') - Phi(s)), Phi(s) = -|theta|/(12*2*pi/360), Phi(s') = 0 only at a true termination (1e-9)
checks.S9: outcome schema (name, version, categories) is the evaluator's and every recorded outcome is one of its categories
checks.S10: replay on the test seeds; exact comparison of length, original_return, training_return, outcome, terminated, truncated; exact / numerical-difference (other platform, Holm-corrected paired sign-flip and McNemar screen not rejecting at 0.05) / unexpected-difference (same platform) / aggregate-disagreement

crash: any other exit status, or no JSON object on stdout

outcome_schema.name: cartpole
outcome_schema.rules: truncated and not terminated -> balanced_to_time_limit; terminated and |theta| > 12*2*pi/360 -> pole_fell; terminated and |x| > 2.4 -> cart_left_track; otherwise unknown
